verdict.rationale: First-party docs show that Sentry has an Alerts product, Slack and PagerDuty notification/incident integrations, and email alert notifications, which covers the core of routing alerts to the three named channels. The pack contains only page titles and plan blurbs, though, so the rule mechanics are unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented per-rule filters by project, environment and severity; documented threshold types (new issue, frequency spike, affected-user count); independent or hands-on corroboration of alert routing.
